real_data_provenance.claim: Probes 9-11 replay traffic captured over the wire while ten real attacks were executed against a real free5GC 5G standalone core. Probe 9 feeds the captured forged NF-profile request bodies through Horizon's artefact gate BYTE FOR BYTE. Probes 10 and 11 use the real attacker-supplied strings and the real event sequence to drive Horizon's own objects, because 5GAD contains no Horizon artefacts.
real_data_provenance.data_kind: over-the-wire packet capture of attacks actually executed against a real free5GC 5G standalone core (UERANSIM RAN) on a physical test bench; not simulated, not synthesised
not_claimed: that Horizon defends free5GC or any 5G core network function
that probes 1-8 use captured data — they are cryptographic and fail-closed gates, which are properties of the code, not of a dataset
